controls.title: Artifact repository-boundary gate
controls.criterion: Large/restricted artifact classes cannot be embedded in cumulative repo.

controls.title: Protected result feedback exclusion
controls.criterion: Research/HPO/result packets reject protected metrics and champion decisions.

controls.title: Replay tolerance precommitment
controls.criterion: Replay tolerance must exist before stochastic comparison; deterministic mismatch blocks.

controls.title: Experiment-store backup/integrity contract
controls.criterion: Local metadata store can be integrity-checked/backed up without becoming canonical model store.

controls.title: Tracking fallback portability
controls.criterion: Canonical research events remain usable without MLflow.

controls.title: MLflow non-authority boundary
controls.criterion: MLflow state cannot alter canonical promotion/champion or experiment identity.

controls.title: Optuna canonical export boundary
controls.criterion: Optuna study/trial evidence can be mapped to canonical study/result records without protected objectives.

controls.title: Nested-search multiplicity ledger
controls.criterion: Outer variants and inner trials remain linked/countable.

controls.title: Negative-history deduplication
controls.criterion: Exact duplicate/dead-end proposals can be detected before redundant execution.

controls.title: Failure taxonomy separation
controls.criterion: Operational/data/rights/governance failures cannot masquerade as scientific rejection.

controls.title: Worktree evidence-retention gate
controls.criterion: Required evidence persists before worktree deletion.

controls.title: Full W18 executable subsystem gate
controls.criterion: Store/queue/scheduler/tournaments/HPO/replay/artifacts/locks/promotion/admission tests pass.

controls.title: Full-rebuild parent supersession gate
controls.criterion: Only full-rebuild W18 pair is valid W19 parent and preserves every W17 member.

controls.title: W24 synthetic end-to-end and replay-readiness gate
controls.criterion: Real starter boundaries execute end-to-end on synthetic evidence; deterministic replay readiness is proven without claiming empirical historical replay.

controls.title: W24 cross-layer leakage battery
controls.criterion: Future/retrospective/observed-weather/target-game-output leakage cases fail closed before feature/model use.

controls.title: W24 source-landscape refresh evidence
controls.criterion: Targeted current source pass records deltas against W06, source ownership/access/provenance changes and remaining gaps.

controls.title: W24 final architecture challenge
controls.criterion: Major decisions are explicitly KEEP/REVISE/DEFER/REJECT with evidence and controlled repairs.

controls.title: W23 blocker preservation under user-directed W24 sequencing override
controls.criterion: Executing W24 does not change TASK-161/TASK-163/AC-038/THR-011/THR-012 evidence status; unresolved target-hardware evidence is carried to W25.

controls.title: W24 scope-completion gate with explicit external blocker carry
controls.criterion: W24-owned E2E/leakage/source/architecture/packaging work passes while final local-production readiness remains explicitly conditional on AC-038.

threshold_registry.name: Brier-score promotion delta
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: paired canonical-game Brier deltas and development-only variability; numeric value awaits materialized development evidence.

threshold_registry.name: Log-loss promotion delta
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: paired log-loss deltas and development-only stability/tail review; numeric value awaits materialized evidence.

threshold_registry.name: Calibration tolerance
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: development-only calibration intercept/slope/reliability variability; protected test cannot set tolerance.

threshold_registry.name: Score/margin error promotion tolerance
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: paired score/margin error deltas and development-only sampling variability.

threshold_registry.name: A&M specialization incremental-value threshold
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: A&M paired incremental value plus national nondegradation, with no-adjustment valid; numeric value pending.

threshold_registry.name: BAS significance/stability threshold
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: null-first BAS effect/stability/multiplicity protocol; numeric criterion pending development evidence.

threshold_registry.name: Feature-family promotion threshold
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: development-only walk-forward family ablation/stability; protected results cannot promote features post hoc.

threshold_registry.name: Entity-resolution auto-accept confidence threshold
threshold_registry.rationale: W07 disables fuzzy auto-accept because no labeled resolution benchmark exists; W19 may set only from labeled review/error evidence.

threshold_registry.name: Source/domain completeness quality threshold
threshold_registry.rationale: Domain/grain specific; global arbitrary completeness number prohibited.

threshold_registry.name: Forecast freshness SLA
threshold_registry.rationale: Set from actual update cadence/product expectations; stale state must always be visible.

threshold_registry.name: Target-hardware peak-RAM budget
threshold_registry.rationale: Measured on target 32GB environment before hard gate.

threshold_registry.name: Target-hardware runtime budget
threshold_registry.rationale: Measured for material workflows before hard gate.

threshold_registry.name: Data-contract/quarantine tolerance
threshold_registry.rationale: Schema/critical-field violations may be zero-tolerance while noncritical quality thresholds are domain-specific.

threshold_registry.name: OOD trigger threshold
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: development OOD coverage/error/false-warning tradeoff; no numeric warning cutoff yet.

threshold_registry.name: Model-disagreement warning threshold
threshold_registry.rationale: Method frozen W17: development disagreement/error association and warning utility; no numeric warning cutoff yet.
